decision: Separate repository with its own deploy target and link (not inside the slot monorepo)
rationale: Owner wants an independently shareable portfolio piece per game
tradeoffs: Shared patterns (state machine, inspector, audio) are adapted, not imported

decision: Ship deploy configuration only (Netlify, Vercel, GitHub Pages workflow_dispatch); the owner triggers deploys
rationale: Owner controls accounts and when a public link goes live
tradeoffs: Relative base './' chosen so one build works on all three hosts

decision: Single Vite package with ESLint-enforced layers core ← engine ← adapters/audio/config ← board ← ui (ADR-0001)
tradeoffs: Boundaries enforced by lint, not package manifests

decision: Shared spatial module + generic machine runner; game modes plug in via GameMode registry, Plinko registered as planned (ADR-0002)
rationale: Additional spatial modes reuse state/log/inspector/provider infrastructure
tradeoffs: Extra abstraction for the first mode

decision: Whitelist transition table, one reveal in flight, requestId stale guard, location-aware recovery (ADR-0003)
rationale: Double-reveal and stale-response bugs become unrepresentable
tradeoffs: State additions require table and test changes

decision: DOM buttons for cells + one Canvas 2D FX layer; pointer input hit-tested via GridLayout; settle gating waits for response AND animation (ADR-0004)
rationale: Accessible keyboard-first board, compositor-only animations, particles off the React tree
tradeoffs: Two render systems kept aligned by a shared layout

decision: Server-authoritative RoundProvider with SHA-256 seed commitment, idempotent requestIds, mock faults and QA peek (ADR-0005)
rationale: Realistic operator contract and in-browser fairness verification
tradeoffs: Mock server logic ships in the demo bundle

decision: Retries reuse the original requestId; MockProvider caches settled results per requestId; reducer applies only the first answer (DUPLICATE_RESPONSE guard); mid-round errors cannot be dismissed, only retried
rationale: A lost response after the server applied a reveal must never double-apply or desync the board
tradeoffs: Players must retry rather than abandon a round on a mid-round error

decision: Each request attempt owns its timeout handle; a late answer to an earlier attempt cannot cancel a retry's timer
rationale: Found while reviewing the retry path: a shared timer could leave a retried request without a timeout

decision: Pointer picks require pointerdown and pointerup on the same hit-tested cell; button onClick only handles detail===0 (keyboard/AT activation)
rationale: Prevents accidental reveals from touch scroll/drag and double activation from click+pointer
tradeoffs: Custom activation path must be kept in sync with accessibility expectations

decision: Compact portrait ledger for screens <=760px tall (ladder hidden, inline labels); ledger grid track minmax(0,1fr); e2e asserts no page or ledger overflow and >=40px cells at 320-1280px
rationale: Initial portrait layout shrank cells to 19px at 320x640 and clipped ledger content
tradeoffs: Ladder strip unavailable on short phones; next multiplier still shown in the odds row

rationale: vitest 2 bundles vite 5 types; mixing them with vite 6 under exactOptionalPropertyTypes failed typecheck

decision: Author attribution 'Oleg Bobokhidze' in package.json, HTML meta, header subtitle (all viewports), footer and README
